items.headline: Commission disburses €2.9 billion under Ukraine Facility to support financial stability and reforms
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 02 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has released €2.9 billion to Ukraine to support financing needs and maintain the functioning of the country's public administration, as it continues to defend itself against Russia's war of aggression.

items.headline: Microsoft, UAE Cyber Council and Core42 deploy AI cyber defence across government
items.summary: MDASH roll-out builds on Microsoft and Core42’s expanding sovereign cloud investments in the UAE, supporting the nation’s cyber security ambitions through AI-driven threat detection and code security.

items.headline: ESAs call for vigilance over external dependencies, cyber threats and private credit risks
items.summary: ESAs call for vigilance over external dependencies, cyber threats and private credit risks 23 September 2026 Joint Committee Risk monitoring The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) have identified external dependencies, emerging technologies and private credit as key vulnerabilities for the EU financial system in their Autumn 2026 risk update.
